title: Bram and the Hymn
author: Wren Almeida
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
